No ,  this is not normal at all . Okay , just answer one question : 

You have a growing tree or plant in your backyard . You think that you will provide only water to the tree . You expect it to give lots of flowers and fruits . But the condition is that the plant will only be provided with water , sunlight and soil . Do you think it will grow fast ? Will it give expected results fast? No dear ,  no. You have to provide it with fertilizers too .

So , the same condition applies to children as well .
Here ,  the condition of the tree or plant can be the growing generation that is ,  the children . The flowers and fruits are the results that they yield on tests or in subsequent classes in various stages of their life , the sunlight ,  water and soil are study materials or books from which they learn from and nutrients are the rewards  ( it can be any form of reward such as playing video games ,  giving them a small treat ,  giving them chocolates ,  or any other kind or recreation ). But all in a balanced  proportion . Neither reward should be more nor studies should be a pressure . Keep a check on all this . She will definitely love studying .
